standalone_bwrap_probe_after_image_rebui.interpretation: Installing the distro bubblewrap package did not resolve the nested sandbox. The runc container uses Docker's built-in seccomp profile, which blocks clone/unshare operations that create new namespaces; with all capabilities dropped, this is the likely immediate cause of the user-namespace failure. AppArmor may also constrain the operation. The VM has the bwrap-userns-restrict profile file, but the aa-status grep used so far may not match its attachment label; load status is not yet conclusive. The runsc loopback failure matches a known gVisor netstack behavior in which a new namespace's loopback already has addresses that bubblewrap tries to add. These are distinct blockers; neither result is a runtime escape or security comparison.
